configuration_summary.summary: adservice Deployment (boutique) exposes gRPC on container port 9555. The readinessProbe uses grpc on port 9555 (initialDelaySeconds 5), while the livenessProbe uses httpGet on path / port 9555 (initialDelaySeconds 5). Since the container serves gRPC, the HTTP-based liveness probe is a protocol mismatch and a likely cause of abnormal restarts. Resources: 200m/180Mi requests, 300m/300Mi limits; Service is ClusterIP grpc 9555->9555.

telemetry_summary.summary: Observed: adservice pod adservice-d6c9fcc6b-d4nlb has restarted 2 times within ~90s of creation; all other boutique pods are stable with 0 restarts. Pod describe shows liveness probe configured as http-get on port 9555 failing repeatedly (kubelet reports 'Liveness probe failed ... malformed HTTP status code' with binary HTTP/2 preface bytes in the response), causing kubelet to kill and restart the container (Last State: Terminated, Exit Code 143; events show Unhealthy x9 and Killing x3). The container serves gRPC/HTTP2 on port 9555 (readiness probe correctly uses grpc), and adservice logs show Netty Http2Exception 'Unexpected HTTP/1.x request: GET /' — consistent with the liveness probe using HTTP/1.x against an HTTP/2-only server. No active metric alerts. Hypothesis (not yet confirmed): liveness probe protocol mismatch (liveness_probe_incorrect_protocol) is the root cause of the abnormal restarts; the HTTP/1.x probe requests trigger server-side errors and probe failures. Uncertainty: it is not yet verified whether the probe failure is solely protocol-related or also timing/port related; YAML config not yet inspected.

output.reasoning: The adservice container serves only gRPC/HTTP2 on port 9555 (readinessProbe correctly uses grpc), but the livenessProbe is configured as httpGet against the same port. The gRPC server responds with HTTP/2 binary frames to the HTTP/1.x probe, so kubelet sees a malformed HTTP status code, marks the container Unhealthy, and repeatedly kills it (Exit Code 143, restart count 2 within ~90s). Changing the liveness probe to grpc protocol on port 9555 will resolve the abnormal restarts.
